_comment: Prayer catalog (58) across 6 domains: daily_rhythm | struggles | drawing_near | scripture | life_seasons | digital_focus. Topics aligned with the SEO 'Prayer for X' pages so each can deep-link to its in-app prayer. The pipeline generates the full guided script from `brief` + `scriptureRef`. Scripture is quoted from WEB (en) / Louis Segond 1910 (fr) — both public domain.

prayers.title: Morning Prayer
prayers.brief: A gentle prayer to consecrate the day to God before reaching for the phone — surrender worries, set intention, receive His mercies that are new every morning.

prayers.title: Evening Examen
prayers.brief: An Ignatian-style examen: review the day with gratitude, notice where you drifted (including time lost to the phone), confess gently, and resolve for tomorrow.

prayers.title: Rest in Peace
prayers.brief: A calming bedtime prayer to release the day's anxieties, quiet the mind from screens, and rest trusting in God's keeping.

prayers.title: Be Still (Reset)
prayers.brief: A 2-minute breath prayer for the moment you reach for a blocked app — redirect the impulse into stillness and presence with God.

prayers.title: Focus for the Work
prayers.brief: A short prayer to begin a focused work or study session — set the phone away, dedicate the next stretch of time to God, and work as unto Him.

prayers.title: First Light
prayers.brief: A prayer for the very first moment of waking, before the phone — to hear God's lovingkindness in the morning and turn the heart toward Him before the world rushes in.

prayers.title: On the Way
prayers.brief: A prayer for the commute or any travel — instead of filling the time with the feed, entrust your comings and goings to the God whose hand leads you wherever you go.

prayers.title: Grace at the Table
prayers.brief: A short blessing before a meal — pause, set the screen aside, and receive food and company with thanksgiving.

prayers.title: Sabbath Rest
prayers.brief: A prayer to enter set-apart rest — cease from striving and from the device, and let your soul receive the Sabbath rest that remains for the people of God.

prayers.title: Coming Home
prayers.brief: A prayer for the threshold between work and home — lay down the labors and notifications of the day and come to the One who gives rest to the weary.

prayers.title: Peace Over Anxiety
prayers.brief: For anxious moments: name the worry to God, receive the peace that surpasses understanding, breathe and rest in His care.

prayers.title: Strength in Temptation
prayers.brief: When tempted (including the pull of endless scrolling): remember God provides a way out, ask for strength, and turn toward Him.

prayers.title: Riding the Urge
prayers.brief: A 2-minute prayer for the moment the urge to scroll surges — name it, breathe through the wave, and walk by the Spirit instead of feeding the craving.

prayers.title: Free from Comparison
prayers.brief: For the ache of comparison and envy — especially after the feed: stop measuring your life against everyone's highlight reel and receive your own God-given portion.

prayers.title: Letting Go of Anger
prayers.brief: For when anger or irritation has its grip — slow down, name it before God, look underneath it, and release it before it hardens into bitterness.

prayers.title: Courage Over Fear
prayers.brief: For a fearful, anxious moment — hear God's 'do not be afraid,' feel His hand uphold you, and let His perfect love begin to drive out the fear.

prayers.title: Released from Shame
prayers.brief: For the heavy voice of shame, especially after failing again — there is now no condemnation in Christ; trade the accusation for grace and stand up clean.

prayers.title: Never Alone
prayers.brief: For loneliness and isolation, often deepened by the screen — remember the God who goes before you and never leaves you, and let His presence fill the empty room.

prayers.title: When You're Discouraged
prayers.brief: For a downcast, weary soul — speak honestly to God about the discouragement, then gently turn your hope back to Him who is your help and your God.

prayers.title: When You're Overwhelmed
prayers.brief: For a heart that is overwhelmed by stress and worry — cry out to God from the end of yourself and ask Him to lead you to the rock that is higher than you.

prayers.title: A Prayer for Patience
prayers.brief: For impatience and the craving for instant everything — rest in the Lord and wait patiently for Him, trading the endless rush for a quiet, trusting heart.

prayers.title: A Heart of Gratitude
prayers.brief: A prayer of thanksgiving — slow down and name God's gifts, big and small, cultivating a grateful heart.

prayers.title: Honest Confession
prayers.brief: A tender prayer of confession and cleansing — bring what weighs on you, receive forgiveness, walk in the light.

prayers.title: Surrender and Trust
prayers.brief: Lay down control and trust God with the things you cannot fix — lean not on your own understanding.

prayers.title: Adoration and Praise
prayers.brief: A prayer of pure adoration — not asking for anything, simply bowing low to praise God for who He is: Maker, Shepherd, and King.

prayers.title: Listening Prayer
prayers.brief: A prayer of holy silence — quiet the inner scroll, still your heart, and learn to say with Samuel, 'Speak, for your servant hears.'

prayers.title: An Honest Lament
prayers.brief: A guided lament through Psalm 13 — permission to bring your raw 'how long, O Lord?' to God, and to find your way back to trusting in His steadfast love.

prayers.title: Beloved
prayers.brief: A prayer to receive God's delight in you — to hear that He rejoices over you with singing and quiets you with His love, apart from anything you produce or post.

prayers.title: Wisdom for the Way
prayers.brief: For a decision or a confusing season — ask the God who gives wisdom generously and without reproach, and quiet your heart to receive His direction.

prayers.title: Forgiving Others
prayers.brief: For a grudge or a wound you're carrying — bring the person honestly to God, and begin, by grace, to forgive as the Lord has forgiven you.

prayers.title: Psalm 23 — The Lord My Shepherd
prayers.brief: A guided meditation through Psalm 23, line by line, resting in the Shepherd's provision, protection, and presence.

prayers.title: Psalm 91 — Under His Wings
prayers.brief: A guided meditation through Psalm 91 — dwelling in God's shelter and refuge against fear.

prayers.title: The Lord's Prayer
prayers.brief: Pray the Lord's Prayer slowly, phrase by phrase, with a short guided reflection on each petition.

prayers.title: Lectio Divina — Abide in Me
prayers.brief: A Lectio Divina session on abiding in Christ: read, meditate, pray, contemplate — with guided silence between movements.

prayers.title: Psalm 1 — The Rooted Life
prayers.brief: A guided meditation through Psalm 1 — turning from the noise of the scroll to delight in God's word, becoming a tree planted by streams of water.

prayers.title: Psalm 46 — God Our Refuge
prayers.brief: A guided meditation on God as refuge and strength — a very present help in trouble — leading into the stillness of 'be still, and know that I am God.'

prayers.title: Psalm 51 — A Clean Heart
prayers.brief: A guided prayer of repentance through David's psalm — asking God to create a clean heart, renew a right spirit, and restore the joy of His salvation.

prayers.title: Psalm 103 — Bless the Lord
prayers.brief: A guided meditation of praise — blessing the Lord with all that is within you and remembering all His benefits: forgiveness, healing, redemption, and steadfast love.

prayers.title: Psalm 121 — I Lift My Eyes
prayers.brief: A guided meditation through Psalm 121 — lifting your eyes from the screen to the hills, to the Keeper who neither slumbers nor sleeps and guards your going out and coming in.

prayers.title: Romans 8 — Nothing Can Separate
prayers.brief: A guided meditation on Paul's great assurance — that nothing in all creation can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

prayers.title: Praying for Others
prayers.brief: A guided intercession — lift up family, friends, those who are suffering, and the world, holding each before God.

prayers.title: Comfort in Grief
prayers.brief: For a season of loss and sorrow — bring the ache honestly to God, who is near to the brokenhearted, and let yourself be held in grief without rushing to be okay.

prayers.title: Waiting and Discerning
prayers.brief: For a season of waiting or a decision you can't yet see clearly — quiet the urge to force an answer, lay the choice before God, and learn to wait on Him with courage.

prayers.title: A New Beginning
prayers.brief: For the threshold of a new season — a job, a move, a baby, a fresh start — release the former things, name the hopes and fears, and trust the God who makes a way in the wilderness.

prayers.title: In Sickness
prayers.brief: A prayer in illness or pain, for yourself or someone you love — entrusting the body to the God who sustains us on our sickbed, asking for healing and grace to endure.

prayers.title: For My Marriage
prayers.brief: A prayer for your marriage — gratitude, honest concerns, and a longing to put the phone down and turn toward your spouse, the cord of three strands not quickly broken.

prayers.title: For My Children
prayers.brief: A prayer for your children — to be present with them rather than distracted, to model faith, and to entrust their hearts and futures to God.

prayers.title: When Work Changes
prayers.brief: A prayer for job loss, a career change, or work uncertainty — releasing fear about provision and trusting the God who holds plans to give you a future and a hope.

prayers.title: Contentment in Singleness
prayers.brief: A prayer for the single season — to receive your life as a good portion from God, releasing comparison and loneliness, with the lines fallen in pleasant places.

prayers.title: Marking a Milestone
prayers.brief: A reflective prayer for a birthday, anniversary, or year's end — to number your days, give thanks for grace so far, and offer the time ahead to God.

prayers.title: Before I Open My Phone
prayers.brief: A 60-second prayer to pray the instant before that first unlock — hand the morning to God and look up to Him before you look down at the screen.

prayers.title: Caught in the Scroll
prayers.brief: For when you surface from the endless feed — ask God to turn your eyes from worthless things, and gently come back to what is real and life-giving.

prayers.title: A Digital Fast
prayers.brief: A prayer to begin a set-apart break from the screen — follow Jesus who withdrew to a quiet place before dawn, and let the silence make room for God.

prayers.title: Redeeming the Time
prayers.brief: For the grief of hours lost to the scroll — bring the wasted time honestly to God without shame, and ask for grace to walk wisely and make the most of the days.

prayers.title: The Gift of Self-Control
prayers.brief: A prayer to receive self-control as a fruit of the Spirit, not a feat of willpower — surrender the device to God and ask Him to grow a free, ordered heart.

prayers.title: For Our Family's Screens
prayers.brief: A prayer for your household's relationship with screens — that as for you and your house, you would serve the Lord, present with one another more than with devices.

prayers.title: Free from Distraction
prayers.brief: For a scattered, fragmented mind — like Martha, worried and distracted by many things: choose the one needful thing and sit, like Mary, at the Lord's feet.

prayers.title: Breaking the Pull
prayers.brief: For the habit that has its hooks in you — confess the pull of the phone, refuse to be mastered by anything but Christ, and ask for freedom that lasts.
